verdict.rationale: Veo is documented as a programmable model on the Gemini API video docs page, including multi-turn refinement through the Interactions API ([veo-docs-8], [veo-docs-9]). Hands-on reports corroborate real API use: calls to the model ID veo-2.0-generate-001 and paid GCP billing ([veo-comm-18], [veo-comm-17], [veo-comm-16]). The docs also carry a migration notice telling users to move to Gemini Omni Flash or Enterprise platform models to avoid service interruptions ([veo-docs-7]), and probes found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec or llms.txt on ai.google.dev ([veo-probe-1], [veo-probe-2]). Missing for 10: published OpenAPI/machine-readable spec, endpoint/auth/request-schema detail in evidence, clarity on Veo API longevity given the deprecation/migration notice.
